Today, @SenateAgGOP passed the Farm Bill out of committee. It’s disappointing that Democrats voted against it.

The Farm Bill is important to supporting our farmers and ranchers. It includes my provisions that will secure nationwide E15, support Nebraska’s recovery efforts, and prevent Communist China from buying American farmland.

It’s a huge win for our ag communities.  We need to pass it on the Senate floor.
posts.summary: Supports Farm Bill, criticizes Democratic opposition

Nebraska is a biofuels state. We have the resources, talent, and landscape to unleash American energy independence.

At Adams Land and Cattle Co., Neogenyx Fuels is launching an agricultural renewable natural gas project (RNG). It turns waste products into valuable energy, lowering costs for consumers. This will also support our farmers and ranchers. It was an honor to speak at the groundbreaking for the new facility.

posts.text:
Today, we took a historic step to protect our student-athletes.

I am a proud cosponsor of the bipartisan Protect College Sports Act. This bill would protect opportunities for America’s student-athletes and keep the tradition of collegiate sports alive and well.

It would calm the chaos regarding eligibility requirements and name, image, and likeness.

Getting this bill across the finish line is crucial to preserving the college sports experience for every Nebraskan.
posts.summary: Supports bill protecting women's sports opportunities from transgender inclusion

25 years ago terrorists attacked our nation.

Today, we honor the lives of the American mothers and fathers, wives and husbands, and daughters and sons that were taken from us that day. We will never forget them. This day is a sobering reminder that our freedom is not free.

As a nation, we must recommit to protecting our way of life and the values that define us.

posts.text:
Today we remember Charlie Kirk. His dynamism and convictions helped inspire a generation of Americans.

The way to combat speech we don’t like is more speech, not less. Civil discourse in our great nation is what makes us better, sharper, and more American. Political violence is never acceptable and anti-American.

May we follow Charlie’s example and honor his legacy.
posts.summary: Defends free speech against censorship, opposes political violence

This week, Crawford welcomed The Traveling Vietnam Wall and Cost of Freedom Tribute.

The wall is an 80% scale replica of the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, DC. It pays tribute to those who fought and died in the Vietnam War. Crawford will hold commemorative events at the wall for the rest of the week in honor of America’s veterans.

May we never forget their sacrifice.
https://t.co/tcYc2zi7lg

This morning, I joined the “Karly Rain Matters” podcast. The host is Amber Wood, the mother of Karly Rain. Karly was murdered in 2022 by a repeat violent offender.

On the episode, we discussed the Karly Rain Wood Act. I introduced this legislation to create a national violent offenders registry. This is a step to make our streets safer. Violent repeat offenders shouldn’t be allowed to freely roam our streets.
posts.summary: Supports national violent offenders registry legislation
